couplets.en: There was a case between the heart and the lashes.

lines: Aaj phir us ki ru-ba-kari hai
couplets.en: Today it comes before the court again.

lines: Phir usi bewafa pe marte hain
couplets.en: Again I ache for that same faithless beloved.
Once more, this is the life I lead.

lines: Kuchh to hai jis ki parda-dari hai
couplets.en: Something is surely being kept behind the veil.
Once more, a wounded piece of my heart makes its plea.
There is a plea, a sigh, and weeping.
Love's witnesses have been summoned again.
The order has gone out for tears to fall.

lines: Phir kuchh ik dil ko be-qarari hai
couplets.en: The heart is a little restless again.
My breast longs for a wound that cuts deep.
There is a reason you forget yourself, Ghalib.
There is a reason you forget yourself, Ghalib.
